"The Odyssey" (2026) is a film that has received mixed reviews. Here's a summary of some of the opinions:

1. **MovieGuys** rated it 4.0/10, criticizing the film for not accurately representing classical Greek history and mythology. They noted reasonable acting, great sets, and okay action but felt the film was miscast at times. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/6a55abb707cf27ca7fcf26ba).

2. **Manuel São Bento** gave it a high rating of 9.0/10, praising it as a maximalist and faithful adaptation of Homer's poem. He described it as ambitious and well-executed, despite its scale and scope. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/6a57bb188acab94fa30511d1).

3. **AlphaLucifer** was highly critical, rating it 1.0/10. They found the film boring and a poor adaptation of Homer's epic, criticizing it for being bloated and self-important. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/6a5a45359163f0f6e3b855d8).

4. **jwtx** did not provide a rating but described it as the best movie theater experience they've had, praising the pacing and engagement of the film. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/6a5b38243e980640f259175c).

5. **mojo_kensa** also did not provide a rating but criticized the film for going against traditional filmmaking ethos and morals, calling it a poor adaptation of Homer. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/6a5bbe6c1f8d2d17a3e9e2a2).

Overall, "The Odyssey" seems to have polarized audiences, with some appreciating its ambition and others criticizing its execution and faithfulness to the source material.

movie.title: The Odyssey
movie.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

items.author: MovieGuys
items.summary:
Monty Python couldn't improve on this. Suffice to say, someone doesn't know their classical Greek history/mythology too well. They have excavated remains from the site of Troy and undertaken facial recreations. Would it surprise anyone to know they look Greek? Would it surprise anyone, too, to know the main figures of Homer's work, are described clearly, as Greek?

Upsides include reasonable if at times miscast acting, great sets, okay action and top locations.

In summary, I wonder what act...

items.summary: The hype was massive, the crowd was packed, but the boredom in the theatre at the end credits said it all. A 172-minute film felt like it was a 6+ hour watch. "Dune" (2021) has received a total of 15,182 reviews with an average rating of 7.783 out of 10. Here are some of the reviews:

1. **RADIO1'S MR. MOVIE!-MAD AMI 🌠** rated it 10.0/10, praising it as a fabulous film with an Oscar-worthy score by Hans Zimmer. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/616262f133ec2600456a6d65).

2. **Habenula** gave it a 1.0/10, calling it the worst movie they've ever seen and advising not to waste time on it. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/616d9b3abf31f20043e2cbb1).

3. **Tsavo** rated it 6.0/10, sharing a nostalgic connection to the story and appreciating the film despite some reservations. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/6170aecdabdec00043dc778e).

4. **tahmid_007** did not provide a rating but praised the movie for its excellent background music and visual effects, expressing anticipation for part two. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/6171738babdec000622bd805).

5. **Manuel São Bento** rated it 8.0/10, describing it as setting a new standard for epic cinema with its visuals, sound design, and compelling story, despite some pacing issues. [Read more](https://www.themoviedb.org/review/61732977a097dc002a9b722f).

Overall, "Dune" has been well-received, with particular praise for its visuals and music, though opinions vary widely.

movie.title: Dune
movie.overview: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence - a commodity capable of unlocking humanity's greatest potential - only those who can conquer their fear will survive.
